about: Holiday in the Park is a Hillsborough County event for the Apollo Beach area, and the county event calendar lists it for the evening of Friday, December 18, 2026.
The county says the event has taken place for over 14 years and is still going strong, which makes it a long running tradition for families around Apollo Beach, Ruskin and Sun City Center.
The activity list is short and kid friendly: free food, arts and crafts, gifts, face painting, a photo booth and pictures with Santa.
Admission is $1 for ages 5 and older, so younger children come in without a ticket.
The county's Things to Know box says no registration is required and no minimum age applies, so families can arrive any time between 6 and 8 PM.
The event is held at the Apollo Beach Park and Recreation Center on Golf and Sea Boulevard, and the county lists it as an in person event.
Questions go to the county contact on the event page, who can be reached at (813) 981-4201.
Fun 4 Brandon Kids files the event under its Apollo Beach, Ruskin, Sun City Center and Wimauma area, a handy way to see other southern Hillsborough holiday events.
